ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with approximately 65% low-intensity (dark) pixels and 35% high-intensity (white) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous high-intensity zones located bilaterally, separated by a central low-intensity V-shaped region at the peduncle. Low-intensity pixels form a continuous band along the entire trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped indentation with an interior angle of approximately 60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary featuring irregular micro-serrations with an average amplitude of 5-10 pixels. Several macro-notches with depth exceeding 20 pixels are visible along the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a concave trajectory from the median notch, transitioning to a slight convexity before the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed low-intensity pixel clusters at both distal tips; sparse circular dark motifs distributed within the high-intensity white regions of the interior lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel sets of low-intensity linear tracks; a prominent set of 4-5 parallel lines at a 45-degree angle on the left lobe, and several intersecting diagonal tracks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular pixel mass and loss of smooth contour at the left distal tip; localized deep indentations on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct yellowish-tinted pixel cluster located at the lower-left boundary of the high-intensity patch on the left lobe.
